rationale: Prepared whole-shell recurrence removes repeated per-component preparation from compensated fixed-mask response. Independent exact scalar audits disable both residency and materialization; unavailable storage retains component-wise replay and masks tighter than prepared rows retain the API refusal.
revisit_condition: Requalify when source preparation or a derivative backend changes the work balance. Frozen C5-C7 complete E+F improves, while single C1-C2 controls are slower; do not infer a universal benefit or promote low-order hybrid dispatch from kernel timing alone.
